constraints: Should be called from the On Startup or On Server Startup database method; the priority is set in cache for all processes in the current session.
Only works in local mode (4D Server and single-user 4D); it cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Applies to scalar-typed fields only (date, number, string); priority for binary-type fields (BLOBs, texts, pictures, objects) is handled by SET BLOBS CACHE PRIORITY instead.
